ModMetaData.name: ISEKAI DUNGEONS ADD-ON - Isekai RPG Leveling
ModMetaData.author: Poupun
ModMetaData.description:
ISEKAI DUNGEONS — Gates, the Guild and the Tower of Gods
Gates to parallel dungeons tear open on your map, ranked on the same F → Nation ladder as your colonists. Step through and your party lands in a sealed dungeon world: monsters that grow stronger room by room, treasure off the beaten path, and a boss guarding the final hall. Clear it for a hoard, mana cores and a surge of XP. Ignore it, and the gate breaks.
70 DUNGEONS ACROSS 11 WORLDS
- Carved caverns, hives, crypts and infernal abysses, or open worlds under a strange sky: snowfields, forests, ash plains, ruins, foundries, celestial halls and, at the very top, the Voidscape - Every dungeon has its own roster and its own boss: slime ranches, kobold warrens, lich catacombs, dragon roosts, demon courts, mechanoid hives, Midhir's Deep and more - Higher ranks branch into side wings and shortcut loops; rooms wake as you enter them, so you set the pace - 7 room events: rival adventurers, traps, ambushes, guarded hoards, champions, a survivor to carry out, mana springs - Treasure rooms, beast vaults with a tameable creature on the hoard, and mana ore veins worth mining
GATES AND BREAKS
- Local gates open on their own schedule, ranked just below your colony's strength — you choose the rate and the first day in the settings - Each gate carries a countdown. Let it run out and the dungeon breaches: three waves a day apart pour onto your map, weakest first - The gate stays open during a breach: storm in and kill the boss to stop it. Otherwise the boss walks out with the last wave, carrying the hoard as a bounty - Flee any time through the exit; you keep what you carry
REWARDS
- A rank-scaled hoard on every clear, guaranteed mana cores, and full clear XP for every colonist inside - A treasure chest of the dungeon's grade — bronze, silver, gold or jade — opened in its own reveal - 15 named artifact weapons, from S-rank blades to the Nation-rank gods, found only in chests - Gate summoning scrolls, F to SSS: read one at home to open a gate of that rank on your own terms
GUILD CONTRACTS
The Guild finds gates beyond your borders, up to Nation rank: - Located — a gate found before it opens. Leave it too long and it breaks - Broken — the breach has already happened and the monsters are loose on the site - Rescue — a gate broke on another faction's land. Save them for goodwill Every contract pays a finder's fee on top of the dungeon's own loot.
THE TOWER OF GODS
A tower rises on the world map: 100 floors, each one remembered. Cleared floors stay cleared, looted rooms stay empty. - Floor types: gauntlets, labyrinths, vaults, duels, rest floors, open plains and villages with a shopkeeper who trades - Floor 50: the mirror hall. Your party faces perfect copies of itself - Floor 100: Elijah the Hundredth. The colonist who brings her down ascends to Godhood: ageless, immune to disease, deathless unless the brain is destroyed, beyond mental breaks
DEEP DUNGEONS
10 multi-floor descents, posted as Guild surveys, from the 3-floor Slime Cistern to the 10-floor Titan Pit. Each has a final boss at the bottom and most bend the rules: slimes that split, survivors that retreat ahead, the dead following you down, floors that grow back, killing cold, killing heat, a hoard that waits at the bottom.
QUALITY OF LIFE
- Autopilot: a toggle that has a colonist clear the dungeon on their own and climb tower floors, pausing to eat and sleep - A title card on entry, gate names on hover, and five music tracks that follow rank and tower height - 180+ settings in 9 tabs with 6 presets, from Relaxed to Brutal to Tower only
REQUIREMENTS
- Harmony - Isekai RPG Leveling (base mod)
OPTIONAL
- Isekai Creatures add-on — strongly recommended: 45 of the dungeons draw their monsters from its bestiary - Guild Faction add-on — contracts also earn Guild goodwill - DLC dungeons for Royalty, Biotech, Anomaly and Odyssey appear when the DLC is active
TRANSLATIONS
Fully translatable — all text lives in language keys. Translators welcome.
Made by Jelly Creative.
